instruction: Extract the project context, objective, actors, scope, constraints, assumptions, and missing information from the stakeholder input.
input: Project brief for GiftMoss Message Correction: The objective is to review and apply customer requests to correct gift messages before order processing makes the message ineligible for editing. Customers submit gift-message corrections, and each correction must identify the order and replacement message. Order Support Agents record whether package processing has begun. Content Reviewers record replacement messages as accepted or returned, and a returned message must include a reason. Fulfillment Editors update gift messages only when the order stage permits editing and the replacement message is accepted. Customer Communications Clerks send correction outcomes to Customers. Refunds and recipient address changes are outside the project. The editable stages, prohibited-content categories, and outcome delivery channel are undecided.

output.business_objective: Review and apply customer requests to correct gift messages before order processing makes the message ineligible for editing.

instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: GiftMoss Message Correction reviews and applies customer requests to correct gift messages before order processing makes editing ineligible. Customers submit order and replacement-message details, Order Support Agents record processing status, Content Reviewers record acceptance or return decisions and reasons, Fulfillment Editors update eligible accepted messages, and Customer Communications Clerks send outcomes. Refunds and recipient address changes are excluded; editable stages, prohibited-content categories, and the delivery channel remain unresolved.

output.summary: GiftMoss Message Correction supports gift-message changes from customer submission through conditional editing and outcome delivery. Five named roles handle correction details, package-processing status, content decisions and return reasons, eligible message updates, and customer communication; refunds and recipient address changes are excluded, while three implementation details remain unresolved.
output.primary_goal: Review and apply customer requests to correct gift messages before order processing makes the message ineligible for editing.
key_capabilities: Record whether package processing has begun.
Record replacement-message decisions and return reasons.
Update gift messages when the editing conditions are satisfied.
unresolved_points: The editable order stages remain unresolved.
The correction-outcome delivery channel remains unresolved.
